name: X4-Z2 Battle Droid
description: The X4-Z2 Battle Droid was a model of three-legged battle droid used by the Exchange criminal organization on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The Exchange used a number of X4-Z2 droids to patrol the Coronet Boulevard of the Corellian Sector.

data.name: X4-Z2 Battle Droid
data.armament: Blasters mounted to the arms and chin
